title: sisymbrium austriacum subsp. tilieri
intro: Sisymbrium austriacum subsp. tilieri, commonly known as Austrian mustard or Wild Mustard, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is used for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sisymbrium austriacum subsp. tilieri include stimulating digestion and alleviating rheumatic and arthritic pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
